placements.note: Approximate stand-in: the surveyed point of the MINOS far-detector cavern (Soudan mine, 27th level). The offset to the Soudan 2 cavern is not published in the sources read; the two detectors did not operate together (Soudan 2 1989-2001, MINOS far detector 2003-2016).
placements.quote: on the 27th level of the Soudan Underground Mine State Park in northern Minnesota

total_mass.quote: Soudan 2 is a 963 metric ton (770 tons fiducial) iron tracking calorimeter

summary.plain: A block of iron plates and plastic gas tubes, as tall as a small house, that photographs the tracks of particles created inside it.
summary.technical: 224 iron-and-gas drift-tube modules (1 m x 1 m x 2.7 m, 4.3 t each; 8 m wide x 5.5 m high x 16.1 m long), vertical anode wires and cathode strips read out; surrounded by an active aluminium proportional-tube shield covering about 97 % of the solid angle.

technology.quote: iron tracking calorimeter with a honeycomb geometry which operates as a time projection chamber
technology.value: Iron tracking calorimeter with honeycomb geometry operating as a time projection chamber, with plastic drift tubes filled with argon-CO2 gas and an active veto shield
